summary: Honesty-clause self-corrections from eclipse magnetic evaluation (SC-1..SC-4)
detail: Publish in the dated results addendum, not by editing the frozen file: SC-1 our B1-M-001 [-25,-5] nT range was not scaled for a near-sunset eclipse — no pre-registered station shows >=5 nT eclipse-attributable dip; SC-2 uniform-negative sign convention over-specified (Sq sign is latitude-dependent vs the Sq focus); SC-3 Hartland peak obscuration computed 94.4% (18:15 UT, partial 17:18-19:08) vs our frozen 88% +/-2 pp and §4.2.7 "~2 h 45 min" — verify against NASA local-circumstances calculator before editing §4.2.7 prose; SC-4 our +30d evaluation ran 15 days late (2026-09-26 vs target 2026-09-11) — disclose it, since the review criticises the dome for post-close silence. Details in results draft self_corrections[].
